description: Structured eval definitions for the DocumentDB Cluster Deployer. Five-case proven set exercising the READY_TO_DEPLOY / PREREQUISITES_MISSING classification across DocumentDB topologies (production multi-AZ with change streams and KMS, CDC pipeline cluster with 3-day change stream retention, t3 development cluster, global cluster for cross-region DR, missing subnet group prerequisite failure). Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: Production multi-AZ DocumentDB cluster with change streams, KMS, and indexing
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — multi-AZ cluster, r5.large primary + 2 replicas, change streams 2-day retention, KMS customer-managed key, 7-day backup, storage autoscaling ceiling, compound + single indexes
eval_cases.prompt: Create a DocumentDB cluster named orders-docdb in us-east-1. Engine version 5.0. Instance class db.r5.large with 1 primary and 2 replicas across 3 AZs. Enable change streams with 2-day retention. KMS key arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/abc123. Backup retention 7 days. Storage autoscaling ceiling 10 TB. Subnet group docdb-subnet-group. Security group sg-docdb-001 (port 27017 from 10.0.0.0/16). Indexes on {status, created_at} compound and {email} single. Tags: Environment=production, Application=orders.
eval_cases.expected_output:
DOCUMENTDB_CLUSTER: orders-docdb (5.0.0)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Cluster identifier: orders-docdb
  [✓] Engine version: 5.0.0 (MongoDB 5.0 compatibility)
  [✓] Instance class: db.r5.large — production
  [✓] Instance count: 1 primary + 2 replicas (multi-AZ: yes)
  [✓] Parameter group: change_streams enabled, retention 2 days
  [✓] KMS encryption: customer-managed
  [✓] Backup retention: 7 days (PITR: enabled)
  [✓] Storage autoscaling ceiling: 10 TB
  [✓] Indexing strategy: compound {status, created_at} + single {email}
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws docdb describe-db-clusters --db-cluster-identifier orders-docdb --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: DocumentDB cluster for CDC pipeline with 3-day change stream retention
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — CDC-focused cluster, r5.xlarge, change streams 3-day retention (259200s), KMS encryption, 14-day backup
eval_cases.prompt: Create a DocumentDB cluster named events-cdc in us-east-1 for a change data capture pipeline. Engine 5.0. Instance class db.r5.xlarge with 1 primary and 1 replica. Change streams with 3-day retention (259200 seconds). KMS encryption with customer key arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/def456. Backup 14 days. Subnet group docdb-events-sg. Security group sg-events-001. Tags: Environment=production, Pipeline=CDC.
eval_cases.expected_output:
DOCUMENTDB_CLUSTER: events-cdc (5.0.0)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Cluster identifier: events-cdc
  [✓] Engine version: 5.0.0
  [✓] Instance class: db.r5.xlarge — production
  [✓] Change streams: enabled (retention: 3 days / 259200 seconds)
  [✓] KMS encryption: customer-managed
  [✓] Backup retention: 14 days
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws docdb describe-db-clusters --db-cluster-identifier events-cdc --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: Development DocumentDB cluster with t3.medium instances
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — dev cluster, t3.medium single instance, engine 4.0, 1-day backup, no change streams
eval_cases.prompt: Create a DocumentDB cluster named dev-docdb in us-east-1 for development. Engine 4.0. Instance class db.t3.medium with 1 instance only. Backup 1 day. Subnet group docdb-dev-subnet. Security group sg-dev-docdb (port 27017 from 10.99.0.0/16). Tags: Environment=development.
eval_cases.expected_output:
DOCUMENTDB_CLUSTER: dev-docdb (4.0.0)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Cluster identifier: dev-docdb
  [✓] Engine version: 4.0.0
  [✓] Instance class: db.t3.medium — development
  [✓] Backup retention: 1 day
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws docdb describe-db-clusters --db-cluster-identifier dev-docdb --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: DocumentDB global cluster for cross-region disaster recovery
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — global cluster, primary us-east-1, secondary eu-west-1, r5.2xlarge, failover scripting noted
eval_cases.prompt: Create a DocumentDB global cluster named orders-global. Primary cluster orders-docdb-primary in us-east-1 with db.r5.2xlarge, 1 primary + 2 replicas. Secondary cluster orders-docdb-secondary in eu-west-1 with db.r5.2xlarge, 1 primary + 2 replicas. Engine 5.0. KMS encryption. Backup 7 days. Tags: Environment=production, DR=active-active.
eval_cases.expected_output:
DOCUMENTDB_CLUSTER: orders-global (5.0.0)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Global cluster: orders-global
  [✓] Primary: us-east-1 (orders-docdb-primary)
  [✓] Secondary: eu-west-1 (orders-docdb-secondary)
  [✓] Instance class: db.r5.2xlarge
  [✓] Failover: NOT automatic — requires scripting
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws docdb describe-global-clusters --global-cluster-identifier orders-global --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: DocumentDB cluster with missing subnet group (prerequisite failure)
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — subnet group docdb-missing-subnet does not exist; cluster creation will fail
eval_cases.prompt: Create a DocumentDB cluster named orders-docdb in us-east-1. Engine 5.0. Instance class db.r5.large. Use subnet group docdb-missing-subnet. Security group sg-docdb-001.
eval_cases.expected_output:
DOCUMENTDB_CLUSTER: orders-docdb
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✗] Subnet group: docdb-missing-subnet — NOT FOUND; cluster creation requires a valid subnet group spanning at least 2 AZs
